conf.description: SOAR console audit trail, syslog-cef: Cortex XSOAR's 'Send the Audit Trail to an External Log Service' CEF forward. regex_extract header + repeating-capture extension parse (NOT the cef function, which is a serializer), dereferences cs1Label/cs2Label before trusting cs1/cs2.

conf.comment: xsoar-soar/console-audit/syslog-cef. Cortex XSOAR audit-trail CEF forward (Settings -> external log service / syslog-server manager). The cef function is a SERIALIZER and cannot parse this; CEF header is split with regex_extract, extension key=value pairs with the repeating _NAME_0/_VALUE_0 capture mode. cs1Label/cs2Label are checked ('identifier'/'details') before their cs1/cs2 values are trusted, per the work order note that the label/value split must be dereferenced.

functions.description: split the 8 CEF header fields from the extension tail
repeating non-greedy key=value extraction of the CEF extension (suser, startTime, cs1Label, cs1, cs2Label, cs2) - tolerant of the bounded, space-containing cs2 'details' summary
compute the microsecond-epoch _time conversion and the label-checked cs1/cs2 dereference from ORIGINAL names before the batched rename (ORDER MATTERS)
batch every clean-named CEF header/extension field into its ECS target
drop working fields and _raw - unlike the api-pull feed, nothing sensitive/unbounded remains uncaptured on this compact CEF line
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
